chunks: And with this chain of narration, it was said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Do not turn down a drink of honey from whoever brings it to you.

key_terms.شَرَبَةَ: a drink / a serving of drink
key_terms.صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on accepting a gift of honey?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, underscores the Prophetic etiquette of accepting gifts to strengthen social bonds (*mu'akhat*), reflecting the Shia emphasis on *adab* in interpersonal relations. It highlights that rejecting a sincere offering, such as honey, can be perceived as a slight to the giver’s goodwill, thereby fostering unity and preventing estrangement within the community.
